newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Power names UK official as director.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Power names UK official as director.

text.p: Regional utility Scottish Power said on Monday it has appointed a former senior British civil servant as a non-executive director.

Sir Peter Gregson, aged 60, was Permanent Secretary to the Department of Energy from 1985 to 1989 and then Permanent Secretary to the Department of Trade and Industry until his retirement in June this year.
"We are pleased to announce this appointment which will add further strength to the board," chairman Murray Stuart said in a statement.
"Sir Peter has wide experience of energy matters, as well as trade and industry generally, and we look forward to having the benefit of his advice and counsel."
